'''Erhan Çınlar''' (born May 28, 1941,<ref name="cornell"/> [[Divriği]], [[Sivas]]-[[Turkey]]<ref name="divriği"/>) is a [[Probability theory|probabilist]] and [[Professor Emeritus]] at [[Princeton University]]. He was the Norman J. Sollenberger Professor of the department of [[Operations Research]] and [[Financial Engineering]] (ORFE) at Princeton University.<ref>[http://orfe.princeton.edu/people/faculty Faculty of Operations Research and Financial Engineering], Operations Research and Financial Engineering, Princeton University</ref>

== Academic life ==
He received a [[B.S.]] in [[Mathematics]] and a [[M.S.]] and [[Ph.D.]] in [[Industrial Engineering]] and Operations Research, all from the [[University of Michigan]] in 1963, 1964 and 1965, respectively.<ref>[https://www.informs.org/content/view/full/272256 Erhan Çinlar's biography]</ref> His dissertation, ''Analysis of Systems of Queues in Parallel'', was supervised by Ralph L. Disney.

In 1965, he joined the department of Industrial Engineering and Management Sciences as an assistant professor at [[Northwestern University]]. During 1971–1972, he was a visiting professor in the department of Management Science and Engineering at [[Stanford University]], and became full professor of Operations Research in 1972 at [[Northwestern University|Northwestern]]. He then joined the department of Civil Engineering and [[Operations research|Operations Research]] as a professor at [[Princeton University]] in 1985.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.princeton.edu/engineering/eqnews/fall99/dean1.html |title=The Department of Civil Engineering and Operations Research (CEOR) at Princeton |access-date=2016-03-31 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151212160540/http://www.princeton.edu/engineering/eqnews/fall99/dean1.html |archive-date=2015-12-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://www.princeton.edu/pr/news/99/q2/0423-ceor.htm Civil Engineering and Operations Research], Office of Communications at Princeton University announces that the Department of Civil Engineering and Operations Research Faculty split in two on April 9, 1999 in such a way that one will be called Civil and Environmental Engineering; the other will be Operations Research and Financial Engineering.</ref>
 
== Research areas ==
Çınlar is the co-founder (along with [[Chung Kai-lai|Kai-lai Chung]] and Ronald Getoor) of the seminar on [[stochastic process]]es,<ref>[http://depts.washington.edu/ssproc/ssp_history.php SSP History], [[University of Washington]]</ref> an annual conference on probability topics such as [[Markov process]]es, [[Brownian motion]], superprocesses, [[stochastic analysis]], and [[mathematical finance]].<ref>[http://depts.washington.edu/ssproc/index.php Seminar on Stochastic Processes], University of Washington</ref>
